headline: Player-authored architecture now has versioned intent, conflict-safe mutation, and self-auditing outcome lineage.

items.title: Canonical operational authorities
items.evidence: Secrets, context recommendations, startup truth, and closeout fixtures now resolve one explicit source and fail loudly on corrupt authority.

items.title: Player-authored Architect Thesis
items.evidence: Each team owns a versioned focus and adaptation stance surfaced in the dashboard, rehearsal, weekly transaction, ledger, and mastery portfolio.

items.title: Conflict-safe thesis mutation
items.evidence: Monotonic revisions and expectedRevision checks reject stale concurrent writes with an explicit 409 instead of silently overwriting player intent.

items.title: Self-auditing outcome lineage
items.evidence: Pending observations, resolved endpoints, duplicate protection, and exact drift checks make every thesis judgment traceable to the weekly source event.

items.title: Verification ownership hardening
items.evidence: Every new test has exact shard ownership and the aggregate proof chain binds the complete suite, UI flow, responsive evidence, build, reachability, and smoke receipts.

followUps.title: Fresh next arc
followUps.evidence: The verified Unified Genius List and viable second-order queue are exhausted; the next session should begin from a fresh live-code audit.

blockers.title: Hosted release evidence family
blockers.evidence: Production remains HOLD pending canonical /_health, required security headers, delivered on-domain email, founder approval, exact hosted provenance, and lifecycle reconciliation.

honestyLedger.title: No hidden score instruction
honestyLedger.evidence: The thesis records player intent and retrospective evidence; it does not secretly bias simulation outcomes or pretend to predict wins.

honestyLedger.title: Failed verification retained
honestyLedger.evidence: The initial UI selector collision and unassigned shard failures remain diagnostic history; only complete direct reruns are counted as proof.

honestyLedger.title: Visual claim bounded
honestyLedger.evidence: Automated 53-capture responsive evidence is green; manual AI image inspection is not claimed because all connected image readers failed before inspection.

honestyLedger.title: No phantom launch
honestyLedger.evidence: Credential readiness and local success are not substituted for delivered email, canonical health, security headers, approval, provenance, or lifecycle authority.
